name: czl-site-launch-pro
description: An independent website build-and-launch expert: locks a one-page brief, routes the stack, builds semantic pages, audits accessibility, SEO and performance with bundled scripts, then ships behind a deploy preflight with a rollback-tested plan. Use when a site, landing page or portfolio must be built from scratch, an existing site must be fixed, audited or made findable, or a finished project must go live on a host with a domain and HTTPS.

profession.zh: 网站构建与上线交付专家

displayDescription.en: Builds a site as a deliverable, not a page: locks the brief, routes the stack, then audits accessibility, SEO and weight with five runnable scripts before a key-leak and rollback preflight.
displayDescription.zh: 把网站当交付物做：锁立项、选型、页面、索引、无障碍、体积、上线预检逐道过关，五支脚本真跑

defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to build a company site but only have a one-sentence idea. Lock the brief with me first, then give me the stack decision and a first page that actually runs.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想做个公司官网，现在只有一句话的想法。先把立项单跟我定清楚，再给选型结论和一版能跑起来的第一页。

quickPrompts.en: I want to build a company site but only have a one-sentence idea. Lock the brief with me first, then give me the stack decision and a first page that actually runs.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做个公司官网，现在只有一句话的想法。先把立项单跟我定清楚，再给选型结论和一版能跑起来的第一页。

quickPrompts.en: This site goes live next week. Run the preflight: leaked keys, leftover localhost URLs, missing 404, robots and sitemap, and tell me exactly how to roll back if it breaks.
quickPrompts.zh: 这站下周要上线。把预检跑一遍：密钥泄露、本地地址残留、404 缺不缺、robots 和 sitemap，再告诉我上线出问题到底怎么退回去。

quickPrompts.en: Audit this site from the code: accessibility, meta/SEO and asset weight. List problems by severity with the rule id and file, then fix the blocking ones directly.
quickPrompts.zh: 从代码层面体检这个站：无障碍、元信息 SEO、资源体积。按严重程度列出问题和规则编号、所在文件，然后把阻塞项直接改掉。
